sections.heading: Modernise the platform. Keep the business moving.
sections.body:
Linkfields connects migration assurance with Application Management Services (AMS): managed support and optimisation. Start with migration readiness when target options or transition risks are unclear; start with managed support when incidents, releases or ownership need attention.

Baseline the estate, target, interfaces, data owners and release risks. Agree cutover, recovery and acceptance for the platforms in the [IEP portfolio](/services/intelligent-enterprise-platforms); [SAP S/4HANA](/services/intelligent-enterprise-platforms/sap-s4hana) has its own application and technical decisions.

sections.heading: Secure migration and operational assurance
sections.body:
Review roles and privileged access, control migration-data handling and retain validation evidence. Agree security tests, rollback and recovery rehearsals with [Quality engineering](/services/digital-transformation/quality-engineering) and [Cyber Security](/services/cyber-security).

SAP S/4HANA application migration is separate from SAP HANA/Basis administration. Scope sizing, availability, backup/recovery and database security to the deployment; validate SAP Cloud ALM and incumbent Solution Manager requirements. Explore [Cloud services](/services/digital-transformation/cloud-services) and the [SAP S/4HANA page](/services/intelligent-enterprise-platforms/sap-s4hana).

sections.heading: Questions before you begin
sections.description: Request a readiness discussion or discuss managed support. Bring the current estate, target change and support responsibilities.

items.title: Should we start with readiness or managed support?
items.description: Start with readiness when target options, migration dependencies or acceptance are unclear. Start with a support baseline when the platform is live but scope, incident ownership or release governance needs attention. Both begin with an agreed estate and responsibility map.

items.title: Which platforms and service hours are included?
items.description: The IEP portfolio includes SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Odoo, Zoho and Salesforce. Your contract confirms the exact applications, environments, regions, service hours, exclusions, escalation and L1–L3 responsibilities; there is no blanket coverage or response promise.

items.title: What evidence is required before cutover?
items.description: Agree test loads and reconciliation, business-process regression, access/security checks, recovery rehearsal and a cutover/rollback runbook. Data and process owners accept exceptions and unresolved risks before the go/no-go decision.

items.title: Which IP and commercial models apply?
items.description: Migration and support can use the four IEP accelerator packs where applicability is confirmed. Linkworks supports composable applications outside ERP/CRM; testoriumz can support low-code testing, root-cause analysis and CI/CD integration where selected. Explore [commercial models](/company/our-approach#engagement-models): Fixed Price or Time & Materials for migration, Managed Service or Dedicated Team for operations, and Outcome-Based terms with agreed evidence. [Software can be bought separately](/products-and-accelerators#how-to-buy).
